name: ESPN Fantasy
author: tom
description: Live league-wide fantasy football scoreboard in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: A football icon that opens every matchup in the league on hover: score, ESPN's win probability, who is on the field right now, and how much game clock is left.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-poll ESPN. 60s keeps a notification within about a minute of a scoring play.

schema.label: Open on hover
schema.description: When off, the scoreboard opens on click only.

schema.label: Hover delay (ms)
schema.description: How long the pointer must rest on the icon before the scoreboard appears.
